listingTitle: Defer debug and info message formatting
title: Defer debug and info message formatting
why: F-strings, format calls, and string concatenation build the complete message before debug or info logging can decide whether the level is enabled.
suggestion: Pass the format string and values separately to the standard logging API so formatting is deferred until the record is emitted.
limitations: Only debug and info calls on directly imported standard logging modules (including aliases) or locally assigned getLogger, Logger, and LoggerAdapter results are examined.

F-string, string format, and top-level string concatenation arguments are reported; custom, imported, parameter-provided, and cross-method logger identities are not inferred, and direct reassignment or parameter shadowing invalidates known bindings.
Repeated eager logging expressions are grouped to one representative finding per file.
